business_summary: Toho Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products in Japan. It operates in four segments: Pharmaceutical Wholesaling Business, Dispensing Pharmacy Business, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Sales Business, and Other Peripheral Businesses. The company distributes pharmaceuticals, narcotics, reagents, medical equipment and devices, medical materials, and over-the-counter products to hospitals, clinics, and dispensing pharmacies. It also provides customer support systems for patients and medical institutions comprising Future ENIF, an information terminal for pharmaceutical ordering; LXMATE HeLios Cloud, a medical care appointment system; and MIZAR, a centralized administration system of pharmacy operations, as well as L1MON, a patient home delivery service for specialty products. In addition, the company engages in the management of the dispensing pharmacies and health insurance dispensing pharmacies; provision of support home medical care and data processing services; and real estate agency business. Further, it provides generic and injection drugs on consignment; contract manufacturing of ampoule and vial formulations; and contract testing for pharmaceutical quality control and stability testing. Additionally, the company engages in site management organization; planning and sale of information processing equipment; software development and sales; corporate and medical management and consulting; internet business related to pharmaceuticals; general motor truck transportation; cashless payment and factoring; remote detailing; and manufacture and sale of hygienic materials. The company was formerly known as Toho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toho Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2009. Toho Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Toho Holdings Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본에서 의약품 도매 유통에 종사하고 있습니다. 의약품 도매 사업, 조제 약국 사업, 의약품 제조 및 판매 사업, 기타 주변 사업 등 4개 부문으로 운영됩니다. 병원, 진료소, 조제약국에 의약품, 마약류, 시약, 의료기기 및 의료기기, 의료재료, 일반의약품 등을 유통하는 회사입니다. 또한 의약품 주문을 위한 정보 단말기인 Future ENIF; 진료 예약 시스템인 LXMATE HeLios Cloud; 약국 운영의 중앙 집중식 관리 시스템인 MIZAR와 특수 제품에 대한 환자 가정 배송 서비스인 L1MON이 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 조제약국 및 건강보험 조제약국의 관리에 종사합니다. 가정 의료 지원 및 데이터 처리 서비스 제공; 부동산 중개업. 또한 제네릭의약품과 주사제의약품을 위탁판매하고 있습니다. 앰플 및 바이알제제 위탁생산
